context: A mom comforts her young son after a stressful day
purpose: Teach: 果て/負ける/素朴/相性/パニック/頼ま/車内/同居

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日、急なテストでパニックになった。
lines.en: Mom, I panicked during a surprise test today.
lines.style: Quiet, strained opening. Small voice tight with lingering anxiety. Speaks carefully, like he's still catching his breath. Searching for permission to admit it hurt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 大丈夫よ。誰だって、想定外に負けることはある。
lines.en: That's okay. Everyone gets blindsided sometimes — it happens to all of us.
lines.style: Calm, steady reassurance. No false brightness. A gentle exhale underneath, like she's said this before and means it. Eye contact held. Normalizing without dismissing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: バスの車内で、ずっと泣きそうだった。
lines.en: I almost cried the whole way home on the bus.
lines.style: Quieter now, ashamed admitting it. Staccato — the kind of brave that takes effort. Like he's testing whether shame is safe with her. Trailing off on the last word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おばあちゃんと同居してるから、後で電話してあげて。
lines.en: You live with Grandma — give her a call later, okay?
lines.style: Gentle redirecting. Not dismissing his hurt; shifting the channel. Warm, practical. The kind of mother who knows when to hold and when to gently hand off. Light, unforced.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん。先生に頼まれた宿題、夜やる。
lines.en: Okay. I'll do the homework the teacher gave me tonight.
lines.style: Small agreement, gaining steadiness. Not cheerful, but collecting himself. Quiet determination beneath. The voice of a child choosing forward despite the sting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 素朴な気持ちで、頑張ろうね。空の果てまで、応援してるよ。
lines.en: With an honest heart, do your best. I'm cheering for you all the way.
lines.style: Soft, unhurried close. No artifice — just a mother saying what's true. Warmth that reaches without grasping. The kind of tenderness that gives space for him to grow into it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 相性悪い問題も、明日リベンジする。
lines.en: I'll tackle those harder problems again tomorrow.
lines.style: Small voice finding its shape again. Not bright yet, but the hint of forward motion. A whisper of the kid he was before the test. Gentle, determined, still careful.
